description: This PHP script is part of the TestLink open source testing management tool. It functions as an AJAX tree loader for navigating test projects, test suites, and test cases, generating a JSON structure representing hierarchical nodes with associated actions and metadata.

methods.name: display_children
methods.description: Generates a list of child nodes for a given parent node, including test project, test suite, and test case nodes, with metadata for AJAX rendering.

methods.name: getAllTCasesID
methods.description: Recursively retrieves all test case IDs under specified node IDs, used to count test cases within test suites.

search-terms: test suite and test case navigation
